title: Apollo telemetry data and original footage destroyed

tellings.quote: Also, the all the telemetry data was destroyed, which is crazy.

plain: The original footage and telemetry data from the Apollo moon missions, the stream of measurements radioed back from the spacecraft, are said to have been destroyed. The comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan says it to Michels on the show without naming a source: "all the telemetry data was destroyed, which is crazy." To Rogan it is a strange loss of the record of the moon landings.
